title: Recruitment of student helpers [Web development and AI Research]
bodyText: Student helpers are invited to support web development and AI research. Undergraduate students with Python, JavaScript, data analysis or web development experience are welcome. Paid hourly work; details will be confirmed with shortlisted applicants.

title: HK$230 Stipend: EEG Experiment Opportunity for Chinese Mainland Students
bodyText: Chinese Mainland undergraduate students are invited to take part in an EEG language-processing experiment. Native Mandarin speakers are preferred. Participants receive an HK$230 stipend after completion.

title: Recruitment of Native Cantonese-speaking Participants — HK$250
bodyText: Native Cantonese speakers are invited to participate in a psychology experiment about Chinese two-character words. Participants will receive HK$250 after completion.

title: Student Helper Recruitment (For data analysis)
bodyText: A CUHK research project is recruiting a student helper for data cleaning and analysis. Experience with Python or R is an advantage. Work schedule and remuneration will be discussed during interview.

title: Up to HK$1100 cash — Sleep–Wake Patterns and Depressive Mood Study
bodyText: Recruiting participants aged 18 or above for a study on sleep–wake patterns and depressive mood. Eligible participants may receive up to HK$1100 cash after completing all sessions.

title: AI + Music: Recruiting Young Music Lovers
bodyText: Join an artificial intelligence and popular-song emotion categorization research study. Young music lovers are welcome. Eligibility and compensation details will be confirmed by the research team.
